What this session will help you understand

  • Where five AI engineering roles overlap and where they differ.
  • How engineering fundamentals connect to current AI tools.
  • How to choose a learning direction that fits your starting point.

The five roles

  1. Forward Deployed Engineer

    Connect customer problems to working AI solutions in real environments.

  2. Applied AI Engineer

    Build useful applications around models, retrieval and evaluation.

  3. Agentic AI Engineer

    Design tool-using workflows with clear boundaries and checks.

  4. AI Solutions Architect

    Translate business needs into coherent AI system designs and trade-offs.

  5. AI Platform / LLMOps Engineer

    Support deployment, observation and reliable operation of AI systems.

Tools and technologies

A practical map of where these tools fit, rather than a tutorial in each one.
